title: Test5 — Furnishing Status Effect on Price
prompt: Analyze whether furnishing status affects housing price. Calculate average prices by furnishing category and explain the results.
model_output: Furnished ~5,495,700 / Semi-furnished ~4,907,524 / Unfurnished ~4,013,831. Concluded furnishing status is a strong positive indicator of price.
notes: Note: these open-ended-test averages differ from H07's benchmark averages (708413.04/496000.00/314464.71) for the same categories — worth checking whether Test5 used a different subset/grouping logic or made a computation error, since H07 and Test5 should reconcile if both are correct.
